code:
reward = staked_amount x rate x time

1,000 tokens staked at 10% annual rate, 90 days:
reward = 1,000 x 0.10 x (90 / 365)
reward = 1,000 x 0.10 x 0.2466
reward = 24.66 tokens
caption: Simple, non-compounding accrual -- the rate applies to your original principal.

eyebrow: APR vs. APY -- compounding changes the number
code:
APY = (1 + APR / n)^n - 1       n = periods per year

10% APR, compounded daily   (n=365): APY = 10.516%
10% APR, compounded monthly (n=12):  APY = 10.471%
10% APR, no compounding     (n=1):   APY = 10.000%
caption: More frequent compounding widens the gap between advertised APR and realized APY.
